author: EyeAmStewPeed
body:
Hi there! 
I've been banned from avicus cause of flyhacks.
But the guy that was flyhacking wasn't me!
I had some problems in 2014 with my account, the skin and password changed the whole time!
So I obviously know that the account hacker was hacking on Avicus.
I think its not fair to ban someone that didn't do anything (except playing on it)!
Avicus was my favorite server because it has nebula.
I think nebula is the best minigame.
Its better thank SG.
So I hope I can play on the server soon!

-Bram a.k.a Sabskrubber

(Sorry for bad grammar, I'm Dutch)
